hints.title: How do you know an island is finished?
hints.body: When you find a land cell, every land cell reachable by moving up, down, left, or right belongs to the same island. How can you visit all of them exactly once?

hints.title: Flood the island
hints.body: Scan the grid. When you find an unvisited `1`, increase the count and flood that island: visit every connected land cell and mark it so it is not counted again.

hints.title: Use an explicit stack
hints.body: A stack or queue avoids recursion limits. Push the starting cell. While the stack is not empty, pop a cell, skip it if it is out of bounds or already water, mark it as water, and push its four orthogonal neighbors.
